item.title: Feature Request: Add settings option to control ask_questions auto-approve behavior
item.body:
## Description

When `chat.agent.autoApprove` is set to `true`, the `ask_questions` tool is also auto-approved, causing it to always return `{"skipped": true}` without presenting any UI to the user. There is **no setting in VS Code** to independently control the auto-approve behavior of `ask_questions`.

## Current Behavior

- `chat.agent.autoApprove: true` auto-approves **all** tools, including `ask_questions`
- Terminal commands have granular control via `chat.agent.autoApprove.terminal.allowList` / `chat.agent.autoApprove.terminal.commands`
- But there is **no equivalent setting** for `ask_questions`: no `chat.agent.autoApprove.askQuestions` or similar option exists
- This means users who want auto-approve for file edits, searches, terminal commands etc. are forced to also auto-approve `ask_questions`, which defeats the purpose of the tool

## Expected Behavior

A dedicated setting should exist to control `ask_questions` independently, for example:

```jsonc
// Option A: Simple boolean
"chat.agent.autoApprove.askQuestions": false  // default: false

// Option B: Per-tool granularity (more general solution)
"chat.agent.autoApprove.tools": {
  "ask_questions": false,
  "read_file": true,
  "replace_string_in_file": true,
  // ...
}
```

This way, users can keep `chat.agent.autoApprove: true` for productivity while ensuring `ask_questions` always presents its UI for user interaction.

## Use Case

When using agent mode / Plan Agent, the model calls `ask_questions` to clarify requirements or confirm decisions before proceeding. With global auto-approve on, this confirmation step is silently skipped, causing the agent to proceed without user input — which defeats the purpose of Plan mode's interactive planning phase.

## Relationship to #14105

Issue #14105 reports that `ask_questions` always returns `skipped:true`. The root cause in many cases is likely `chat.agent.autoApprove: true` silently skipping the UI. Even if #14105 is fixed as a bug, a **settings-level control** for `ask_questions` auto-approve is still needed as a feature.

## Environment

- OS: Windows
- VS Code: Stable (latest)
- GitHub Copilot: Latest
